profile.headline: Senior/Staff Software Engineer | Java Backend Specialist | REST APIs & Ad Platform Integrations (Google Ads, TikTok, Amazon) | Scalable Systems & Algorithmic Optimization | Austin, TX
profile.summary:
I specialize in building robust Java backend systems that power high-throughput advertising and content platforms. Currently at Adlucent, I lead integrations for our in-house campaign management platform with Google Ads API, TikTok Marketing API, and Amazon Ads API—enabling real-time synchronization, automated bidding, and optimized performance at scale.

My foundation in applied mathematics (M.A./B.S. from UT Austin) and early C/C++ scientific computing gives me a strong edge in algorithmic efficiency and performance tuning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led end-to-end integration of in-house campaign management platform with Google Ads API, TikTok Marketing API, and Amazon Ads API using Java backend and RESTful services; enabled seamless account synchronization, real-time reporting, and automated campaign controls for enterprise-scale advertising operations.

- Led seamless migration of authentication system from custom Tomcat database Realm to OAuth2-based service (Auth0), enhancing security, eliminating password storage risks, and enabling modern features like MFA/SSO. Achieved zero-downtime transition with no user disruption.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · REST APIs · Tomcat · Software Development

positions.description: Systems design and implementation. Technical direction for offshore teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web Application Architect/Developer
• Used open source software to build a highly customized network sharing solution.
• Architect: Management console for network sharing application. An MVC design using Struts on Tomcat/Jetty.
• Worked on integration of Java and Linux system level services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core Server Engineer (Java/C++)
UI Engineer (Java/Windows) - Developed and maintained managment consoles for Vignette's platforms StoryServer and V6

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Services Consultant
•Java: Middleware Servlet development 
•Unix: Porting of various enterprise applications (Tivoli, Novell) to and from different Unix flavors such as Solaris, HP/UX, and Digital UNIX.
•Various other Java and C++ projects.
•Worked onsite at Tivoli (1 year contract) providing technical services such as custom software development, porting, and supporting Tivoli staff on technical customer calls.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
UNIX System and Network Programmer (C/C++), XWindows developer
•Lead/Owner: X/Windows based simulation and visualization tool for acoustic research modeling.
•Developed fast 3D contouring algorithm based on triangulated meshes.
• Wrote command line based UNIX tools.
• Implemented TCP/IP networking support for various modeling and simulation systems

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
C/C++ Programmer, XWindows developer
•  Developed highly versatile 3D surface interpolating algorithm based on natural neighbor interpolation and blending functions.
• Learned how to write high-performance number crunching code in C and C++.
• Wrote UNIX and Macintosh tools to support acoustic modeling research projects.
